en.longDescription:
Prefect is a Python-native workflow orchestration platform for scheduling, observing, and automating data and application workflows.

This template starts Prefect Server with local persistent storage for quick self-hosted deployments.

de.longDescription:
Prefect ist eine Python-native Workflow-Orchestrierungsplattform zum Planen, Beobachten und Automatisieren von Daten- und Anwendungs-Workflows.

Dieses Template startet Prefect Server mit lokalem persistenten Speicher für schnelle Self-Hosted-Bereitstellungen.

fr.shortDescription: Plateforme d'orchestration et de planification de workflows
fr.longDescription:
Prefect est une plateforme d'orchestration de workflows native Python pour planifier, observer et automatiser les workflows de données et d'applications.

Ce template démarre le serveur Prefect avec un stockage persistant local pour des déploiements auto-hébergés rapides.

pt.shortDescription: Plataforma de orquestração e agendamento de workflows
pt.longDescription:
Prefect é uma plataforma de orquestração de workflows nativa em Python para agendar, observar e automatizar workflows de dados e aplicações.

Este template inicia o Prefect Server com armazenamento persistente local para implantações auto-hospedadas rápidas.
